tools.description: Every MT4, MT5 and cTrader account linked to this API key: id, nickname, platform, broker server, login and connection status (connected / connecting / disconnected / error). Call this first: the other tools take its account_id values. Set include_balances to also read each account's live balance, e

tools.name: get_open_positions
tools.description: Open positions and pending orders on one or more accounts, newest first, with per-account counts, floating profit and swap, and totals per currency. Lists at most 300 orders across all accounts; counts and totals always cover everything. Narrow it with symbol (EURUSD also matches EURUSD.sd) and kind

tools.name: get_trade_history
tools.description: Closed positions (one row per round trip) on one or more accounts, with per-account stats: trade count, wins, losses, win rate, net profit after commission and swap, best and worst trade, and a per-symbol breakdown. Defaults to the last 7 days; the window can be up to 366 days. Lists at most 300 tra

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Find the exact symbol names an account's broker uses, by case-insensitive substring. Brokers spell instruments differently (EURUSD, EURUSD.sd, EURUSDm, XAUUSD.r), so look a name up here before calling get_quotes, get_symbol_info or get_price_history. Returns up to limit names (default 100) with how

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Latest bid, ask and spread for up to 20 symbols, read live from this account's terminal, so prices are the broker's own. A symbol the broker does not know is listed under errors while the others still return; if none resolve, the call fails. The current price only: for past prices use get_price_hist

tools.name: get_symbol_info
tools.description: Contract specification for one symbol at this account's broker, read live from its terminal: digits, contract size, tick size and value, minimum/maximum/step volume, stops level, current spread, swap rates, commissions and trading sessions. symbol must be the broker's exact name, so look it up with

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: OHLC candles for one symbol from this account's broker. Returns the most recent `limit` bars (default 100, max 500) in the window; omit from/to for the latest bars. A window spanning more than 20000 bars is refused (narrow it or pick a larger timeframe). For the current price only, use get_quotes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_symbols" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find the exact symbol names an account's broker uses, by case-insensitive substring. Brokers spell instruments differently (EURUSD, EURUSD.sd, EURUSDm, XAUUSD.r…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
